question: Palak is the daughter of Nihal. Sulochna is the mother of Yashasvi. Prayag is the brother of Yashasvi. Pritam's only son Nihal is the father of Prayag. How is Sulochna related to Palak?
solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols,

 [IMAGE: https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/FyD9L3PCPvZsHa5nynlMPf_fzf_aXK9tKopSaDWxBYVwFRo-6fzjiv7HQG28YUhFJ0nLGj9_hEV_JqW5NQsWS_FX2dnhd3UTkTZ5DE4dKFyqgfFDku2-8QBz2pL7YIeD6iwR5lii] 

1) Palak is the daughter of Nihal.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d22376d38db16c3a0a4446139a07ab4c8ba7e6e4028d02d367559f4dade2197e.png] 

2) Sulochna is the mother of Yashasvi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/530b7a55358232574f48795c2b93ed913cfb004bb68393841d8c139597cb28f3.png] 

3) Prayag is the brother of Yashasvi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7f5311652b4d61db1d4925a04e0ab068c7c28dee4ee9366eeca8889f33436108.png] 

4) Pritam's only son Nihal is the father of Prayag.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce85e8ba04d9bdec57bac67f0197280fcb29757a4e539d65a3c93a9d6a7f461d.png] 

Final complete family tree is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20b76fc8a240b3fb1c2c9f8918ee9372f8ea42e0cf87c4dc313490890b7b06d1.png] 

Clearly, we can see that Sulochna is mother of Palak.

Hence, the correct answer is "Mother".
